definition_zh: 生物多样性；基因、物种与生态系统各层次的总体差异
definition_en: the total variety of living things counted together across genes within a species, species in a place and the ecosystems they build
core_image: 一条样带从溪谷铺到山脊，同一树种在不同高度长成不同模样，叶色、株形与身旁的植物层层换样
scene: 一支调查队沿山坡设下样带，从溪谷走到山脊，逐层记录物种、个体差异与群落组合。The team measured biological diversity from the stream bank to the ridge.
sceneCN: 这里指从基因、物种到生态系统多个层次的总体差异（第 1 个义项：各层次生命形式的总体多样性）；句意为调查队测量了从溪岸到山脊的生物多样性。

pos.zh: 生物多样性（不可数短语名词）
生物多样性总量（用于统计与政策文本）

collocations.zh: 某一地区的生物多样性

derivatives.zh: 由该短语前部与表示「多样」的核心词缩合而来，义为「生物多样性」，是日常与政策文本的通用简称
由该短语的缩合形式加形容词词尾构成，义为「生物多样性丰富的」
该短语的限定部分，由表示「生命」的希腊词根加学科词尾构成，义为「生物的；生物学的」
由该形容词加副词词尾构成，义为「从生物学角度看；在生物层面」
该短语的核心词，由拉丁语表示「转向不同方向」的词而来，义为「多种多样的」
由表示「多样」的形容词加动词词尾构成，义为「使多样化」
由该动词加表示动作结果的名词词尾构成，义为「多样化；多元化」

senses.title: The whole variety of life at every level
senses.titleCN: 各层次生命形式的总体多样性
senses.definition: the total range of variation among living things, counted together across genes, species and ecosystems
senses.definitionCN: 生物在基因、物种与生态系统各层面上差异的总和
senses.example: Biological diversity is the broadest term for the variety of life on earth.
senses.exampleCN: 生物多样性是描述地球上生命差异的最宽泛的说法。
senses.why: The phrase joins a Greek word for life with a Latin word for being turned apart, so it names the spread of living forms rather than any single form.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语把表示「生命」的希腊词与表示「被转向不同方向」的拉丁词合在一起，因此指的是生命形态的分开与铺展，而不是某一种形态。

senses.title: Variation inside a single species
senses.titleCN: 同一物种内部的遗传变异
senses.definition: the genetic differences among individuals and populations of the same species
senses.definitionCN: 同一物种的个体与种群之间在基因上的差别
senses.example: The biological diversity inside one grass species can exceed what a walker notices.
senses.exampleCN: 一种禾草内部的生物多样性，可能超过一个路人所能察觉的程度。
senses.why: Every level above the gene is built from inherited differences, so the phrase starts at the smallest unit that can vary.
senses.whyCN: 基因以上的每一层都由可遗传的差异搭建，因此这个短语从能够发生变化的最小单位讲起。

senses.title: The number and spread of species
senses.definition: the number of species present in a place and how individuals are distributed among them
senses.definitionCN: 一个地方出现的物种数目，以及个体在这些物种之间的分布状况
senses.example: A count of breeding birds is a common way to describe biological diversity at the species level.
senses.exampleCN: 统计繁殖鸟类的数量，是描述物种层面生物多样性的常见做法。
senses.why: Species are the units that field surveys can see directly, so counts of them became the standard face of the term.
senses.whyCN: 物种是野外调查能直接看见的单位，因此物种计数成了这个术语最常用的面目。

senses.title: Variety of ecosystem types
senses.titleCN: 生态系统类型的多样性
senses.definition: the range of ecosystem types, such as forest, wetland and grassland, found within an area
senses.definitionCN: 一个地区内森林、湿地、草原等生态系统类型的多寡
senses.example: Mangrove, mudflat and seagrass bed give the estuary its biological diversity.
senses.exampleCN: 红树林、泥滩与海草床共同构成了这片河口生物多样性中的生态系统层次。
senses.why: Living things build their own surroundings, so differences among communities appear as differences among whole systems.
senses.whyCN: 生物会改造自身的周围环境，因此群落之间的差别会表现为整个系统之间的差别。

senses.title: Mosaic of habitats and communities
senses.titleCN: 生境与群落的镶嵌组合
senses.definition: the patchwork of habitats and communities packed closely together within a landscape
senses.definitionCN: 一片景观中紧密相邻、彼此镶嵌的生境与群落组合
senses.example: The reserve protects biological diversity in a tight mosaic of bog, heath and old woodland.
senses.exampleCN: 保护区在一片由沼泽、石南与老龄林地紧密镶嵌的地带中维护着生物多样性。
senses.why: Habitat edges multiply the kinds of places available, and the phrase counts that multiplication as variety.
senses.whyCN: 生境边缘会成倍地增加可用的场所类型，这个短语把这种成倍增加也算作多样性。

senses.title: Variety of ecological roles
senses.definition: the range of functional roles, such as grazing, pollination or decomposition, filled by organisms
senses.definitionCN: 生物所承担的取食、传粉、分解等功能角色的多样程度
senses.example: Pollinators and seed dispersers add a functional layer to biological diversity that species counts miss.
senses.exampleCN: 传粉者与种子传播者为生物多样性增加了一层物种计数看不见的功能维度。
senses.why: Two places can hold the same number of species yet work differently, so the term was widened from names to jobs.
senses.whyCN: 两地可以有同样的物种数目而运转方式不同，于是这个术语从「名字」扩展到了「职责」。

senses.title: A measured index
senses.definition: a quantity estimated from field surveys and reported through indices of richness and evenness
senses.definitionCN: 由野外调查估计、以丰富度与均匀度等指数报告出来的数量
senses.example: The team reported biological diversity as a single index for each plot.
senses.exampleCN: 团队把每个样方的生物多样性汇总成一个指数报告。
senses.why: Policy needs a number, so the phrase came to name the output of a survey as well as the thing surveyed.
senses.whyCN: 政策需要数字，因此这个短语既指被调查的对象，也指调查算出的结果。

senses.title: A stock of natural capital
senses.definition: the living variety treated as a resource supporting food, medicine, pest control and stable production
senses.definitionCN: 把生命多样性当作支撑食物、药物、害虫控制与稳定生产的资源存量
senses.example: Farmers near the delta depend on biological diversity for pest control and soil fertility.
senses.exampleCN: 三角洲附近的农户依靠生物多样性获得害虫控制与土壤肥力。
senses.why: Once variety is seen to do work for people, it is accounted for like a stock rather than a list.
senses.whyCN: 一旦人们看出这种差异在为人类做事，它就会被当成一项存量来核算，而不再只是一份名单。

senses.title: A target of conservation and policy
senses.titleCN: 保护与政策的目标对象
senses.definition: the object of international commitments and national law aimed at slowing or halting its loss
senses.definitionCN: 国际承诺与国内立法所要维护、以减缓或阻止其丧失的对象
senses.example: The convention treats biological diversity as a matter of common concern.
senses.exampleCN: 该公约把生物多样性视为共同关切的事项。
senses.why: The same word now appears in treaties and statutes, so it has become the name of an obligation and not only of a fact.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词如今出现在条约与法规里，于是它成了一种义务的名称，而不只是一种事实的名称。

intro.en: The phrase is a modern scientific compound. A Greek word for life supplies the first element and a Latin word for being turned apart supplies the second, and the two were joined in English only in the twentieth century.
intro.cn: 这个短语是近代科学复合词：前一部分来自希腊语表示「生命」的词，后一部分来自拉丁语表示「被转向不同方向」的词，两者直到二十世纪才在英语里合在一起。

items.en: Bios meant life or a way of living, and it entered scientific compounds as the element for living things.
items.cn: 这个词意为生命或生活方式，后来作为表示「生物」的构词成分进入科学术语。

items.en: Logos meant word, account or reasoned study, and the study of life took its name from it.
items.cn: 这个词意为言辞、论述或有条理的研究，关于生命的学问由此得名。

items.en: French coined the name of the science in the early nineteenth century, and English borrowed it soon after.
items.cn: 法语在十九世纪初造出这门学科的名称，英语随后借用。

items.en: Divertere meant to turn aside or apart, and its participle described things drawn in different directions.
items.cn: 这个词意为转开、分开，其分词形式描述被拉向不同方向的事物。

items.en: Diversitas named difference and variety, and English diversity came through French from it.
items.cn: 这个词表示差异与多样，英语中表示「多样性」的名词经法语由此而来。

items.en: The full phrase was taken up by biologists in the twentieth century and was fixed in international law by the convention of 1992; the exact first use is dated only approximately.
items.cn: 这个完整短语由生物学家在二十世纪启用，并经一九九二年公约写进国际法；其确切首见年份只能给约数。

note.en: The first group shares the parts of the phrase; the second group names neighbouring measures of living variety.
note.cn: 第一组与本短语共用构词成分；第二组是与「生命多样性」相邻的其他度量说法。

entries.definition: The shortened compound now used in most policy and media texts.
entries.definitionCN: 由本短语缩合而成的简称，现多用于政策与媒体文本。

entries.definition: The adjective for what belongs to life or to the science of life.
entries.definitionCN: 表示属于生命或生物学的形容词。

entries.definition: Varied, of several different kinds; the core adjective behind diversity.
entries.definitionCN: 指多种多样、种类不同；是 diversity 背后的核心形容词。

entries.definition: To add more kinds, in farming, business or investment.
entries.definitionCN: 指在农业、商业或投资中增加种类。

entries.definition: The whole zone of life on earth; it shares the life element but not the variety element.
entries.definitionCN: 指地球上生命存在的整个圈层；共用一个「生命」成分，但不含「多样」成分。

entries.definition: The number of species in a sample or area, one component of the wider term.
entries.definitionCN: 指一个样地或地区的物种数目，是更宽泛术语的一个组成部分。

entries.definition: The variety of ecosystem types alone, one layer of the whole.
entries.definitionCN: 只指生态系统类型的多样性，是整体中的一个层次。

entries.definition: Variation among genes within a species or population.
entries.definitionCN: 指一个物种或种群内部基因层面的变异。

entries.definition: A looser everyday phrase for the range of living things in a place.
entries.definitionCN: 较宽松的日常说法，指一地生物种类的多寡。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations walk down the levels of the phrase, from life as a whole to genes, species and habitats.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想沿着这个短语的层次往下走，从整体生命到基因、物种与生境。

normal.en: Bio is life and diversity is being turned apart, so the word literally describes life spread into many forms.
normal.cn: 前部是「生命」，后部是「被分开」，字面上就是生命铺展成许多形态。

normal.en: The shortened form biodiversity drops three syllables and keeps the meaning, which is why headlines prefer it.
normal.cn: 缩合形式省掉了几个音节而保留原意，所以标题更爱用它。

normal.en: The levels run gene, species, ecosystem: small to large, and the phrase covers all three.
normal.cn: 层次从基因、物种到生态系统由小到大，这个短语三层全包。

normal.en: A single hillside transect can show three of the levels in one afternoon.
normal.cn: 一条山坡样带一个下午就能展示其中三个层次。

normal.en: The 1992 convention made the phrase a legal term, so it appears in treaties as well as textbooks.
normal.cn: 一九九二年的公约使这个短语成为法律术语，因此在条约与教科书里都会出现。

abstract.en: Diversity is not a list of names but the distance between them: the gaps carry the information.
abstract.cn: 多样性不是一串名字，而是名字之间的距离，信息藏在间隔里。

abstract.en: Every level repeats the same shape: many variants kept in one system that still works.
abstract.cn: 每一层都重复同一个形状：许多变体被保存在一个仍能运转的系统里。

abstract.en: Losing diversity is losing options that were never used, which is why the loss is hard to price.
abstract.cn: 丧失多样性就是丧失从未被用过的选项，这正是这种损失难以定价的原因。

examples.en: Tropical forests hold the greatest biological diversity of any terrestrial habitat.
examples.cn: 热带森林拥有的生物多样性超过任何其他陆地生境。

examples.en: The survey linked falling biological diversity to draining the marsh.
examples.cn: 这项调查把生物多样性下降与排干沼泽联系了起来。

examples.en: Protecting biological diversity also means protecting the genetic stock of crops.
examples.cn: 保护生物多样性也意味着保护作物的遗传资源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「拜欧洛吉扣 戴维西提」——拜欧是生命，戴维西提是分开铺展，生命铺开成许多样子，就是生物多样性

root: 希腊语 bios「生命」+ 希腊语 logos「论述、学问」构成表示「生物的」形容词；拉丁语 diversus「被转向不同方向」← divertere「转开」← vertere「转动」构成表示「多样性」的名词；两词在英语中于二十世纪合为固定短语，一九九二年由生物多样性公约固定为法律术语，完整短语的确切首见年代只能给约数。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses move from the whole of life inward to genes, then outward again through ecosystems, functions, measurement, resource value and policy.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从整体生命向内走到基因，再向外经生态系统、功能、度量、资源价值直到政策。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hillside sampled from stream to ridge shows a different living community at every height.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条从溪谷取样到山脊的山坡，每升高一段就换一套生物群落。

branches.en: THE WHOLE AND ITS JOBS: every level counted together, and the roles that different organisms fill.
branches.cn: 整体与职责：各层次合并计数，以及不同生物承担的生态角色。

branches.en: THE HIDDEN LAYER: inherited differences inside one species, invisible in a species list.
branches.cn: 隐藏的一层：同一物种内部可遗传的差异，在物种名单里看不见。

branches.en: THE VISIBLE LAYER: the species a survey can name and count.
branches.cn: 可见的一层：调查能够命名并计数的物种。

branches.en: THE BUILT LAYER: ecosystem types, and the tight mosaic of habitats inside a landscape.
branches.cn: 搭建起来的一层：生态系统类型，以及景观内部紧密镶嵌的生境。

branches.en: THE ACCOUNTED LAYER: an index, a stock of natural capital, and an obligation written into law.
branches.cn: 被核算的一层：一个指数、一份自然资本存量，以及写进法律的义务。

intro.en: The phrase is built from one Greek life element and one Latin turning element, and both still generate new words.
intro.cn: 这个短语由一个希腊语「生命」成分和一个拉丁语「转向」成分构成，两者至今仍在生成新词。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the second half: vertere, its participle diversus and the noun diversitas, all recorded forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供后半部分：动词、其分词与名词三种有记录的形式。

items.example: It opens a large family of scientific compounds.
items.exampleCN: 它开启了一整族科学复合词。

items.example: It turns a subject into a discipline.
items.exampleCN: 它把一个对象变成一门学科。

items.example: It makes the adjective of the discipline.
items.exampleCN: 它构成该学科的形容词。

items.example: It carries the idea of separation inside the word.
items.exampleCN: 它在词内承载「分开」的意思。

items.example: The same stem gives convert, reverse and version.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干还给出「转换」「反转」「版本」等词。

items.example: It makes the abstract noun of variety.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「多样」的抽象名词。

items.example: The participle is the direct source of the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词是形容词的直接来源。

items.example: It is the recorded noun behind the English word.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录的、英语词所本的名词。

derivatives.zh: 由该短语缩合而成，义为「生物多样性」
由缩合名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「生物多样性丰富的」
由核心形容词加动词词尾构成，义为「使多样化」
由该动词加表示动作结果的名词词尾构成，义为「多样化」

definition_zh: 天然生境；自然栖息地；物种原本栖居的环境
definition_en: the environment in which a species lives without human replacement of its food, shelter or breeding conditions
core_image: 林间一片未被开垦的湿地，芦苇从水里长到岸上，鸟在苇丛深处筑巢，四周没有围栏与水泥
scene: 山谷深处那片湿地没有被排干，也没有围栏，鸟仍在苇丛里筑巢。The reserve keeps the natural habitat of the heron intact.
sceneCN: 这里指物种在无人改造的条件下原本栖居的环境（第 1 个义项：物种自然存活的环境）；句意为保护区让这种鹭的天然生境保持完整。

pos.zh: 天然生境；自然栖息地
某物种的原生分布环境

derivatives.zh: 该短语的核心词，由拉丁语「它栖居」一词直接借来，义为「生境；栖息地」
由表示「居住」的拉丁词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「居住；住所」
由表示「在内」的前缀加表示「持有、占据」的词干构成，义为「栖居于」
由该动词加表示施动者的名词尾构成，义为「居民；栖居者」
由该动词加表示「可……的」的形容词尾构成，义为「可居住的」
由表示否定的前缀加该形容词构成，义为「不自然的；反常的」

senses.title: The environment a species lives in unaided
senses.titleCN: 物种无需人工维持即可栖居的环境
senses.definition: the surroundings in which a species finds food, shelter and breeding conditions without human replacement of them
senses.definitionCN: 某一物种无需人类代为提供食物、隐蔽与繁殖条件即可获得这些条件的环境
senses.example: The orchid survives only in its natural habitat, where a specific bee pollinates it.
senses.exampleCN: 这种兰花只在其天然生境中存活，那里有特定的蜂为它传粉。
senses.why: Habitat is a Latin form meaning it dwells, so the phrase points to the dwelling a species occupies by itself.
senses.whyCN: 生境一词本义是「它居住」，因此这个短语指向物种自己占用的那个居所。

senses.title: The native range of a species
senses.definition: the geographic area where a species evolved or arrived without human transport
senses.definitionCN: 某一物种在无人为搬运的情况下演化形成或自然到达的地理范围
senses.example: Outside its natural habitat the frog is replaced by a close relative.
senses.exampleCN: 在其原生分布区之外，这种蛙会被近缘种取代。
senses.why: Range and dwelling overlap in the wild: a species occupies the ground it is fitted to.
senses.whyCN: 在野外，分布范围与居所是重叠的：一个物种占据的是它已经适应的那片地面。

senses.title: A habitat type such as forest or marsh
senses.titleCN: 森林、沼泽这类生境类型
senses.definition: a category of environment defined by its vegetation, water and climate rather than by one species
senses.definitionCN: 按植被、水体与气候划分的环境类别，而不是按单一物种划分
senses.example: Reedbed is a natural habitat that filters water as well as sheltering birds.
senses.exampleCN: 芦苇荡是一种天然生境，在庇护鸟类的同时也过滤水质。
senses.why: Classification works upward from physical conditions, so the same phrase names a kind of place as well as a home.
senses.whyCN: 分类是从物理条件往上归并的，因此同一个短语既指一个家，也指一类地方。

senses.title: The set of requirements a species needs
senses.titleCN: 物种生存所需的生境要件
senses.definition: the specific combination of food, cover, water and breeding sites a species requires
senses.definitionCN: 某一物种所需的食物、隐蔽物、水源与繁殖场所的特定组合
senses.example: Draining the spring removed a requirement of its natural habitat.
senses.exampleCN: 排干泉水，就等于抽掉了它天然生境中的一项要件。
senses.why: A habitat can be described as a list of conditions, and the phrase covers that list as well as the place.
senses.whyCN: 生境可以被描述成一份条件清单，这个短语既指地点，也指那份清单。

senses.title: Undisturbed, original condition
senses.definition: the state of an environment before drainage, clearing or other human change
senses.definitionCN: 在排水、开垦或其他人为改变之前的环境状态
senses.example: The marsh was returned to something close to its natural habitat.
senses.exampleCN: 这片沼泽被恢复到接近其原始天然状态。
senses.why: Natural carries the sense of what is born with a thing, so the phrase can mark a baseline rather than a location.
senses.whyCN: 「天生的」这一形容词带有「与生俱来」的意思，因此这个短语可以标出一条基准线，而不只是一个位置。

senses.title: A legally protected natural area
senses.titleCN: 受法律保护的天然生境区域
senses.definition: an area given legal protection because it supports species that depend on it
senses.definitionCN: 因其维系着依赖它的物种而受到法律保护的区域
senses.example: Building within the natural habitat of the turtle now requires a permit.
senses.exampleCN: 在这类龟的天然生境内施工，现在需要许可证。
senses.why: Protection attaches to the place itself, so the phrase shifts from ecology to law.
senses.whyCN: 保护直接附着在地点上，于是这个短语从生态学滑向了法律。

senses.title: The object of loss and degradation
senses.titleCN: 生境丧失与退化的对象
senses.definition: what is measured, mapped or lost when land is converted or polluted
senses.definitionCN: 土地被转用或受污染时被测量、绘图或丧失的对象
senses.example: Road building is the leading cause of natural habitat loss in the region.
senses.exampleCN: 修路是该地区天然生境丧失的首要原因。
senses.why: Anything countable can be lost, and the phrase became the unit in which losses are reported.
senses.whyCN: 凡是可计数的东西都会丧失，这个短语于是成了报告损失时使用的单位。

senses.title: A rebuilt substitute for the original
senses.definition: a constructed or restored area designed to replace habitat that was destroyed
senses.definitionCN: 为替代已被破坏的生境而人工建造或恢复的区域
senses.example: The ponds were dug as a natural habitat for the displaced amphibians.
senses.exampleCN: 这些池塘是为被迁走的两栖动物挖出的替代天然生境。
senses.why: The word keeps its shape even when people do the building, because the aim is to mimic the original conditions.
senses.whyCN: 即使由人来建造，这个词仍保持原样，因为目标是模仿原来的条件。

intro.en: Both halves are Latin borrowings. Natural goes back to the verb to be born, and habitat is a Latin verb form meaning it dwells, taken whole into English as a noun.
intro.cn: 两半都是拉丁语借词：前半「天生的」追溯到「出生」这一动词，后半「生境」本是拉丁语动词形式「它居住」，整体借入英语后作名词用。

items.en: Nasci meant to be born, and its participle produced the adjective for what belongs to birth.
items.cn: 这个词意为出生，其分词形式给出了表示「与生俱来」的形容词。

items.en: Natura named the course of birth and the character a thing is born with, hence nature.
items.cn: 这个词指出生的过程与事物天生的性质，于是有了「自然」之义。

items.en: Habere meant to have or hold, and it underlies the frequentative verb for occupying a place.
items.cn: 这个词意为持有、占据，是表示「反复占据某处」的动词的来源。

items.en: Habitare meant to dwell or inhabit, and English inhabits several words from this stem.
items.cn: 这个词意为居住、栖居，英语从这一词干借入了好几个词。

items.en: The third person singular of the verb, meaning it dwells, was borrowed unchanged as an English noun in the eighteenth century.
items.cn: 该动词的第三人称单数形式意为「它居住」，十八世纪被原样借入英语作名词。

items.en: English then added natural in front to separate the original dwelling from a substitute one; the combination is a modern descriptive phrase.
items.cn: 英语随后在前面加上表示「天生」的限定词，用以区分原本的居所与替代的居所，这一组合是近代描述性短语。

note.en: The first group shares habitat or nature; the second group names the places and conditions a species needs.
note.cn: 第一组共用 habitat 或 nature 的成分；第二组是表示物种所需场所与条件的相邻说法。

entries.definition: The core noun: the place and conditions where an organism lives.
entries.definitionCN: 核心名词：生物生活的地点和条件。

entries.definition: The act of dwelling, or a place built for people to live in.
entries.definitionCN: 指居住行为，或供人居住的处所。

entries.definition: To live in a place, used of animals, plants and people.
entries.definitionCN: 指栖居于某处，动物、植物与人皆可用。

entries.definition: One who lives in a place.
entries.definitionCN: 指居住在某地者。

entries.definition: A person who studies living things in the field; it shares nature but not habitat.
entries.definitionCN: 指在野外研究生物的人；共用一个「自然」成分，但不含生境成分。

entries.definition: The area a species occupied before human transport, close to the range sense of the phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 指物种在人为搬运之前占据的区域，接近该短语的分布区义。

entries.definition: A community plus its physical surroundings, a larger unit than a habitat.
entries.definitionCN: 指生物群落加上其物理环境，是比生境更大的单位。

entries.definition: The specific place where a species reproduces, one requirement within a habitat.
entries.definitionCN: 指物种繁殖的具体场所，是生境要件之一。

entries.definition: Land untouched by human use, close to the undisturbed sense.
entries.definitionCN: 指未经人类使用的土地，接近「未受扰动」义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the Latin verb it dwells and the real compounds built on it.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用拉丁语「它居住」这一动词，以及由它构成的真实复合词。

normal.en: Habitat is a whole Latin verb form, so it says it dwells rather than dwelling.
normal.cn: 「生境」是一个完整的拉丁语动词形式，说的是「它居住」，而不是「居住」这个抽象动作。

normal.en: Inhabit, inhabitant and habitation all sit on the same holding stem.
normal.cn: 「栖居」「栖居者」「住所」都站在同一个表示「占据」的词干上。

normal.en: A zoo cage can satisfy an animal but it is not its natural habitat, because the conditions are supplied.
normal.cn: 动物园的笼子能满足动物，但不是它的天然生境，因为条件是被人供给的。

normal.en: Natural marks what is born with a thing, so the phrase always implies a baseline before human change.
normal.cn: 「天生的」标记与生俱来的东西，因此这个短语总暗示人为改变之前的基准。

normal.en: Restoring habitat means rebuilding the water, cover and breeding sites a species lost.
normal.cn: 恢复生境就是重建物种失去的水、隐蔽物与繁殖场所。

abstract.en: Habitat is a fitted shape: the species is cut to the place, and the place is cut to the species.
abstract.cn: 生境是一个彼此贴合的形状：物种被裁成地方的样子，地方也被裁成物种的样子。

abstract.en: Losing habitat is not moving a house but deleting the address the species was born with.
abstract.cn: 丧失生境不是搬走一座房子，而是删掉物种与生俱来的那个地址。

abstract.en: A substitute habitat can imitate the structure and still miss the history that filled it.
abstract.cn: 替代生境可以模仿结构，却仍可能缺失曾把它填满的那段历史。

examples.en: The bats lost their natural habitat when the cave was opened to visitors.
examples.cn: 洞穴向游客开放后，这些蝙蝠失去了天然生境。

examples.en: Reedbeds are the natural habitat of many declining marsh birds.
examples.cn: 芦苇荡是许多数量下降的沼泽鸟类的天然生境。

examples.en: The plant grows far outside its natural habitat in warmer gardens.
examples.cn: 这种植物在更温暖的花园里长到了其天然生境之外很远的地方。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「奈扯柔 海比泰特」——奈扯是天生，海比泰特是它住的地方，天生就住的地方就是天然生境

root: 拉丁语 natura「自然、天性」← nasci「出生」构成表示「自然的」形容词；拉丁语 habitat「它居住」，为 habitare「栖居」的第三人称单数，habere「持有」的反复形式；该形式十八世纪直接借入英语作名词，与表示「自然的」形容词组合为近代描述性短语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from the dwelling a species occupies by itself, through range, type, requirements and baseline condition, to law, loss and reconstruction.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从物种自己占用的居所出发，经分布区、类型、要件与基准状态，直到法律、丧失与重建。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an undrained marsh where reeds, water and nesting birds hold their own arrangement without a fence.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片未排干的沼泽，芦苇、水与筑巢的鸟在没有围栏的情况下自行保持秩序。

branches.en: THE PLACE AND ITS TYPE: the dwelling a species occupies and the category of environment it belongs to.
branches.cn: 地点与类型：物种占用的居所，以及它所属的环境类别。

branches.en: THE MAP: the native range that holds the dwelling at geographic scale.
branches.cn: 地图：在地理尺度上容纳这一居所的原生分布区。

branches.en: THE CHECKLIST: food, cover, water and breeding sites that must all be present.
branches.cn: 清单：食物、隐蔽物、水源与繁殖场所必须齐备。

branches.en: THE BASELINE AND THE COPY: original condition, and the rebuilt substitute that tries to imitate it.
branches.cn: 基准与复制：原始状态，以及试图模仿它的人工替代。

branches.en: THE LEDGER: protected ground on one side, and measured loss on the other.
branches.cn: 账本：一边是受保护的地面，一边是被计量的丧失。

intro.en: One Latin birth stem and one Latin dwelling stem carry the whole phrase, and each still builds new English words.
intro.cn: 一个拉丁语「出生」词干和一个拉丁语「居住」词干撑起整个短语，两者至今仍在造新词。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies recorded forms for both halves: nasci and natura on one side, habere, habitare and habitat on the other.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语为两半都提供了有记录的形式：一边是「出生」与「天性」，另一边是「持有」「栖居」与「它居住」。

items.meaning: belonging to birth or inherent character
items.example: It marks what is not supplied by people.
items.exampleCN: 它标记非由人供给的东西。

items.structure: Latin verb form used as noun
items.meaning: it dwells; the place where something lives
items.example: The form was borrowed whole, not derived in English.
items.exampleCN: 该形式是整体借入，并非英语内部派生。

items.example: It is the base of the dwelling verbs.
items.exampleCN: 它是诸「居住」动词的基座。

items.example: It supplies the noun and the English verb.
items.exampleCN: 它提供了名词与英语动词。

items.example: It marks living inside a place.
items.exampleCN: 它标记「住在里面」。

items.example: It makes the word for a resident.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示居住者的词。

items.example: It makes the noun for the act of dwelling.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示居住行为的名词。

items.example: It is the recorded source of the first half.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录的、前半部分的来源。

latinEntries.structure: Latin verb form, third person singular

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语动词形式整体借入，义为「生境」
由表示「在内」的前缀加表示「持有」的词干构成，义为「栖居于」
由该动词加施动名词词尾构成，义为「栖居者」
由该词干加动作名词词尾构成，义为「居住；住所」

definition_zh: 生态系统多样性；一个区域内生态系统类型及其内部组合的多样性
definition_en: the variety of ecosystem types in an area and of the communities and physical settings that make each of them up
core_image: 同一片山地并排着三种地面：针叶林、泥炭沼泽与碎石草甸，交界处各自伸出不同的植物
scene: 测绘员在同一条山脊上标出森林、沼泽与草甸的边界，三块地彼此相邻却各有一套物种。The map records the ecosystem diversity of the whole catchment.
sceneCN: 这里指一个区域内生态系统类型及其组合的多样程度（第 1 个义项：生态系统类型的多样性）；句意为这张图记录了整个流域的生态系统多样性。

pos.zh: 生态系统多样性（不可数短语名词）
生态系统层次上的多样性（生物多样性三层次之一）

collocations.zh: 生态系统多样性的丧失
某区域的生态系统多样性

derivatives.zh: 该短语的限定词，由希腊语表示「家宅」的词与表示「组合整体」的词构成，义为「生态系统」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「生态系统的；系统层面的」
该短语的核心词，由拉丁语表示「转向不同方向」的词而来，义为「多样的」
由表示「多样」的形容词加表示性质的名词词尾构成，义为「多样性」
由表示「多样」的形容词加动词词尾构成，义为「使多样化」
由表示「农田」的成分加该名词构成，义为「农业生态系统」

senses.title: Variety of ecosystem types
senses.titleCN: 生态系统类型的多样性
senses.definition: the number and range of ecosystem types, such as forest, marsh, lake and grassland, present in an area
senses.definitionCN: 一个地区内森林、沼泽、湖泊、草原等生态系统类型的数量与种类跨度
senses.example: Ecosystem diversity falls sharply when the marsh and the dry meadow are both replaced by one plantation.
senses.exampleCN: 当沼泽与干草甸都被同一片人工林取代时，生态系统多样性会急剧下降。
senses.why: Diversity at this level counts whole systems, so the unit is a type of place rather than an organism.
senses.whyCN: 这一层的多样性以整个系统计数，因此单位是一类地方，而不是一个生物。

senses.title: Variety inside one ecosystem
senses.titleCN: 单一生态系统内部的组合差异
senses.definition: the range of communities, substrates and water conditions contained within a single ecosystem
senses.definitionCN: 一个生态系统内部所包含的群落、基底与水文条件的多样程度
senses.example: A large floodplain shows high ecosystem diversity even though it counts as one ecosystem type.
senses.exampleCN: 一片大河漫滩虽然只算一个生态系统类型，却表现出很高的内部组合多样性。
senses.why: One system still holds many patches, and the phrase covers that interior variety as well.
senses.whyCN: 一个系统内部仍有许多斑块，这个短语也涵盖这种内部的差异。

senses.title: One of the three levels of biodiversity
senses.titleCN: 生物多样性三个层次之一
senses.definition: the ecosystem level in the standard three-part account of biological diversity, alongside genes and species
senses.definitionCN: 在通行的生物多样性三层次划分中，与基因、物种并列的生态系统那一层
senses.example: Reports on biological diversity usually treat ecosystem diversity as a separate chapter.
senses.exampleCN: 关于生物多样性的报告通常把生态系统多样性单列一章。
senses.why: The three-level scheme was built for measurement, so each layer needed its own name.
senses.whyCN: 三层次框架是为度量而建的，因此每一层都需要自己的名称。

senses.title: Landscape-scale pattern
senses.titleCN: 景观尺度的格局多样性
senses.definition: the spatial arrangement and patchiness of ecosystems across a landscape
senses.definitionCN: 生态系统在景观上的空间排布与斑块化程度
senses.example: Satellite images show the ecosystem diversity of the delta as a shifting patchwork.
senses.exampleCN: 卫星影像显示，这片三角洲的生态系统多样性是一片不断变化的镶嵌格局。
senses.why: Arrangement matters as much as number, which is why mapping became the standard method.
senses.whyCN: 排布与数量同样重要，所以制图成了标准方法。

senses.title: A classified and mapped quantity
senses.definition: a figure produced by classifying land cover into ecosystem units and summing their extent
senses.definitionCN: 把地表覆盖划分为生态系统单元、再统计其范围所得出的数值
senses.example: The survey reported ecosystem diversity per square kilometre of the catchment.
senses.exampleCN: 调查按流域每平方公里报告了生态系统多样性。
senses.why: Classification rules decide the number, so the phrase often means the output of a map rather than a fact in the field.
senses.whyCN: 分类规则决定了数目，因此这个短语常指一张图的产出，而不是野外的直接事实。

senses.title: Variety of ecosystem processes
senses.titleCN: 生态系统过程的多样性
senses.definition: the range of processes, such as flooding, fire and nutrient cycling, that different systems perform
senses.definitionCN: 不同系统所执行的洪水、火烧、养分循环等过程的多样程度
senses.example: Fire-prone grassland and waterlogged fen add a process dimension to ecosystem diversity.
senses.exampleCN: 易火的草原与常年积水的沼泽为生态系统多样性增加了一层过程维度。
senses.why: Two systems with similar species can still work differently, so the term widened from parts to operations.
senses.whyCN: 两个物种相近的系统仍可能以不同方式运转，因此这个术语从「部件」扩展到了「操作」。

senses.title: A spatial unit for conservation planning
senses.titleCN: 保护规划中的空间单元
senses.definition: the set of ecosystem types used to select reserves and set representation targets
senses.definitionCN: 用来选择保护地、设定代表性目标的那一组生态系统类型
senses.example: Planners asked which ecosystem diversity the network still fails to represent.
senses.exampleCN: 规划者追问，这个保护网络仍然没有代表哪些生态系统多样性。
senses.why: Conservation works by types of place, so this level became the currency of reserve design.
senses.whyCN: 保护工作按地方的类型来做，这一层于是成了保护地设计的通用货币。

senses.title: An indicator of resilience
senses.titleCN: 恢复力与稳定性的指标
senses.definition: a measure of how many alternative systems a landscape can draw on when conditions change
senses.definitionCN: 衡量景观在条件变化时能调用的替代系统有多少的指标
senses.example: A landscape with high ecosystem diversity is less likely to lose all production in one drought.
senses.exampleCN: 生态系统多样性高的景观，在一次干旱中失去全部产出的可能性更小。
senses.why: Where one system fails another can take over, so variety at this level is read as insurance.
senses.whyCN: 一个系统失灵时另一个可以接手，因此这一层的多样性被读作保险。

senses.title: The contrast with species diversity
senses.definition: a level distinguished from species counts because a species-rich site can still hold only one system
senses.definitionCN: 与物种计数相区别的层次，因为物种丰富的地点也可能只有一种系统
senses.example: Two sites with equal species lists can differ widely in ecosystem diversity.
senses.exampleCN: 两份物种名单相同的地点，可能在生态系统多样性上差别很大。
senses.why: Counts of organisms and counts of systems answer different questions, so the term is defined partly by what it excludes.
senses.whyCN: 数生物与数系统回答的是不同问题，因此这个术语有一部分是靠排除来定义的。

intro.en: The phrase joins a term coined in nineteen thirty-five from two Greek words with a Latin word for variety. It is a twentieth-century scientific compound with a traceable author.
intro.cn: 这个短语把一九三五年用两个希腊词造成的一个术语，与一个表示「多样」的拉丁词合在一起，是作者可考的二十世纪科学复合词。

items.en: Oikos meant house or household, and it supplied the idea of the whole place where life is carried on.
items.cn: 这个词意为房屋或家户，提供了「生命在其中展开的整个场所」这一想法。

items.en: Systema meant an organized whole made of parts, from the verb to set together.
items.cn: 这个词意为由各部分组成的有机整体，出自「放在一起」这一动词。

items.en: The botanist Arthur Tansley coined ecosystem to name the organisms and their physical setting as one unit.
items.cn: 植物学家坦斯利造出表示「新系统」的新词，把生物与其物理环境视为一个单位。

items.en: Divertere meant to turn apart, and its participle described things drawn in different directions.
items.cn: 这个词意为转开，其分词形式描述被拉向不同方向的事物。

items.en: Diversitas named difference and variety, and English diversity came through French.
items.cn: 这个词表示差异与多样，英语中表示「多样性」的名词经法语而来。

items.en: Ecologists later put the coined unit in front of the borrowed noun to name the ecosystem level of variety; the exact first use is dated only approximately.
items.cn: 生态学家后来把这个新造的单位放在借来的名词前面，用以命名多样性中的生态系统层次；确切首见年代只能给约数。

note.en: The first group shares ecosystem or diversity; the second group names the other levels and close measures of variety.
note.cn: 第一组共用 ecosystem 或 diversity；第二组是多样性的其他层次与相邻度量。

entries.definition: Organisms plus their physical surroundings treated as one working unit.
entries.definitionCN: 指生物加上其物理环境，被视为一个运转的单位。

entries.definition: The study of those units and their relations; it shares the house element, not the system element.
entries.definitionCN: 指对这些单位及其关系的研究；共用一个「家宅」成分，不含「系统」成分。

entries.definition: The state of being varied, the core noun of the phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 指多样的状态，是本短语的核心名词。

entries.definition: Of several different kinds.
entries.definitionCN: 指包含多种不同种类。

entries.definition: Household management; it shares the house element but belongs to a different stem.
entries.definitionCN: 指家政管理；共用一个「家宅」成分，但属于另一词干。

entries.definition: The umbrella term covering genes, species and ecosystems together.
entries.definitionCN: 指把基因、物种与生态系统一并涵盖的总称。

entries.definition: Variety measured at the level of species rather than systems.
entries.definitionCN: 指在物种层次而非系统层次度量的多样性。

entries.definition: The range of habitat patches, often counted within one ecosystem.
entries.definitionCN: 指生境斑块的多样程度，常在一个生态系统内计数。

entries.definition: The mixedness of a landscape, a spatial cousin of the term.
entries.definitionCN: 指景观的混合程度，是这个术语在空间上的近亲。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the coinage date, the two Greek parts and the three-level scheme.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用造词年代、两个希腊成分与三层次框架。

normal.en: Oikos is house and systema is a set of parts, so an ecosystem is a household of parts.
normal.cn: 前半是「家宅」，后半是「部件的组合」，所以生态系统就是一堆部件组成的家。

normal.en: Tansley coined the word in nineteen thirty-five, which makes it younger than the telephone.
normal.cn: 坦斯利在一九三五年造出这个词，它比电话还年轻。

normal.en: The three levels are genes, species and ecosystems, and this phrase names the third.
normal.cn: 三个层次是基因、物种与生态系统，这个短语命名的正是第三层。

normal.en: Two sites can share a species list and still differ here, because the list is not the map.
normal.cn: 两个地点可以物种名单相同，在这一层却不同，因为名单不是地图。

normal.en: Mapping is the usual method, since a type of place has to be drawn before it can be counted.
normal.cn: 常用方法是制图，因为一类地方要先画出来才能计数。

abstract.en: Ecosystem diversity is variety of arrangements, not variety of parts: the same species can be organised into different wholes.
abstract.cn: 生态系统多样性是排布方式的多样，而不是部件的多样：同样的物种可以被组织成不同的整体。

abstract.en: A landscape keeps several ways of working alive at once, and that redundancy is its insurance.
abstract.cn: 一片景观同时让几种运转方式活着，这种冗余就是它的保险。

abstract.en: Counting systems rather than organisms moves the eye from actors to stages.
abstract.cn: 数系统而不是数生物，视线就从演员移到了舞台。

examples.en: Ecosystem diversity in the delta depends on keeping both fresh and salt marsh.
examples.cn: 三角洲的生态系统多样性取决于淡水沼泽与盐沼都被保留下来。

examples.en: The assessment ranked ecosystem diversity above species counts for reserve selection.
examples.cn: 这项评估在选择保护地时把生态系统多样性排在物种计数之前。

examples.en: Planting a single tree species across the plain reduced ecosystem diversity sharply.
examples.cn: 在平原上遍植单一树种，使生态系统多样性急剧下降。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「伊扣西斯特姆 戴维西提」——伊扣是家，西斯特姆是部件组合，一个家加上许多套部件组合，就是生态系统多样性

root: 希腊语 oikos「家宅」+ 希腊语 systema「由部分组成的整体」→ 英语中表示「生态系统」的新词，一九三五年由坦斯利造出；拉丁语 diversus「被转向不同方向」← divertere ← vertere「转动」→ 表示「多样性」的名词。两词在二十世纪合为固定短语，确切首见年代只能给约数。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses count whole systems, then open them up: interior patchwork, the three-level scheme, landscape pattern, mapping, processes, reserve design and resilience.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项先以整个系统计数，再逐层展开：内部镶嵌、三层次框架、景观格局、制图、过程、保护地设计与恢复力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: three ground types meet along one ridge, each carrying its own set of plants.
core.cn: 核心意象：三类地面在同一条山脊上相接，各自带着一套植物。

branches.en: THE UNIT AND ITS CONTRAST: whole system types, defined partly against species counts.
branches.cn: 单位与对照：整个系统的类型，部分靠与物种计数相区别来定义。

branches.en: THE INTERIOR: communities and substrates packed inside one system.
branches.cn: 内部：一个系统内部紧密排布的群落与基底。

branches.en: THE SCHEME: the ecosystem layer of the three-level account of biological diversity.
branches.cn: 框架：生物多样性三层次中的生态系统那一层。

branches.en: THE MAP: spatial arrangement, and the classified extent that a survey reports.
branches.cn: 地图：空间排布，以及调查报告的分类面积。

branches.en: THE WORK: processes performed, units used in reserve design, and the insurance value of alternatives.
branches.cn: 运转：所执行的过程、用于保护地设计的单元，以及替代方案的保险价值。

intro.en: A Greek house word and a Greek whole word make the unit; a Latin turning word makes the variety.
intro.cn: 一个希腊语「家宅」词和一个希腊语「整体」词构成单位，一个拉丁语「转向」词构成多样性。

latinIntro.en: The first element is Greek, so the Latin entries belong to the variety half only.
latinIntro.cn: 前半是希腊语，因此拉丁语词条只属于「多样性」那一半。

items.example: It marks the whole place where life is carried on.
items.exampleCN: 它标记生命在其中展开的整个场所。

items.example: It marks the unit as a working whole.
items.exampleCN: 它标记这个单位是一个运转的整体。

items.example: It forms the adjective of the unit.
items.exampleCN: 它构成该单位的形容词。

items.example: It carries separation inside the word.
items.exampleCN: 它在词内承载「分开」。

items.example: The same stem gives convert and reverse.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干还给出「转换」与「反转」。

items.example: It makes the abstract noun of variety.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示多样的抽象名词。

items.example: It is the recorded Greek source of the first element.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录的、第一成分的希腊语来源。

items.example: It is the recorded Greek source of the second element.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录的、第二成分的希腊语来源。

derivatives.zh: 由希腊语两个成分构成，义为「生态系统」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「生态系统层面的」
由表示「农田」的成分加该名词构成，义为「农业生态系统」
由核心形容词加动词词尾构成，义为「使多样化」

definition_zh: 环保人士；环保主义者；主张保护环境的人；（作定语）环保主义的
definition_en: a person who works or campaigns to protect the natural environment, or a position that puts environmental protection first
core_image: 一条被垃圾堵住的河口，几个人挽着裤腿下水清理，岸上有人举着写满字的牌子
scene: 河口被垃圾堵了半个夏天，附近居民组成小队下水清理，并一直要求上游工厂整改。A local environmentalist organised the cleanup and the letter to the factory.
sceneCN: 这里指主张并亲自参与保护环境的人（第 1 个义项：以保护环境为行动目标的人）；句意为一位本地环保人士组织了清理行动并起草了给工厂的信。

pos.zh: 环保人士；环保主义者
环保主义的（多作定语，如环保政策、环保主张）

derivatives.zh: 该词的基座，由表示「环绕」的法语词加名词词尾构成，义为「环境」
由该基座名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「环境的」
由该形容词加副词词尾构成，义为「在环境方面」
由该形容词加表示主义、运动的名词词尾构成，义为「环保主义；环保运动」
该词的复数形式，义为「环保人士们」
由表示反对的前缀加该词构成，义为「反环保人士者」

senses.title: A person who works to protect the environment
senses.titleCN: 以保护环境为行动目标的人
senses.definition: a person who takes an active part in protecting air, water, land and living things
senses.definitionCN: 积极参与保护空气、水体、土地与生物的人
senses.example: Every environmentalist in the valley signed the petition against the new road.
senses.exampleCN: 谷地里每一位环保人士都签署了反对新建公路的请愿书。
senses.why: The word adds the agent ending to environment, so it names the person who acts on the thing.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在「环境」后加上表示施动者的词尾，因此命名的是对着环境采取行动的人。

senses.title: A campaigner inside a movement
senses.definition: a member of an organised movement that lobbies, protests and publicises environmental harm
senses.definitionCN: 有组织运动的一员，通过游说、抗议与公开揭露环境损害来行动
senses.example: She became an environmentalist after the river turned grey.
senses.exampleCN: 河水变灰之后，她成了一名环保运动活动者。
senses.why: Movements need a name for their members, and the agent noun filled that slot in the nineteen sixties.
senses.whyCN: 运动需要给成员一个称呼，这个施动名词在二十世纪六十年代补上了这一位置。

senses.title: A professional in environment-related work
senses.titleCN: 从事环境相关工作的专业人员
senses.definition: a person whose paid work is in conservation, environmental science, planning or regulation
senses.definitionCN: 以保护、环境科学、规划或监管为职业的人
senses.example: The agency hired an environmentalist to run the monitoring programme.
senses.exampleCN: 该机构聘请了一位环境专业人员来主持监测项目。
senses.why: Wide use stretched the word from campaigners to salaried staff, and the boundary is now fuzzy.
senses.whyCN: 宽松的用法把这个词从运动者扩展到领薪职员，两者的边界如今已经模糊。

senses.title: Attributive: of an environmentalist position
senses.definition: used before a noun to mark a policy, argument or position that puts environmental protection first
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词前，标记把环境保护置于首位的政策、论点或立场
senses.example: The party adopted an environmentalist platform before the election.
senses.exampleCN: 该党在选举前采纳了一份环保主义纲领。
senses.why: The noun came to modify other nouns, a common English shortcut that avoids building a longer adjective.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词开始修饰其他名词，这是英语里避免另造长形容词的常见捷径。

senses.title: A political stance
senses.definition: a position in party politics that treats environmental limits as central to policy
senses.definitionCN: 在政党政治中把环境限度视为政策核心的立场
senses.example: Green parties grew out of environmentalist politics in the nineteen seventies.
senses.exampleCN: 绿党在二十世纪七十年代从环保主义政治中生长出来。
senses.why: Once the stance entered parliaments, it needed a name that could sit beside other political labels.
senses.whyCN: 这一立场进入议会后，就需要一个能与其他政治标签并列的名称。

senses.title: An advocate inside a company
senses.titleCN: 企业内部的环保倡导者
senses.definition: an employee or manager who pushes environmental standards within a commercial organisation
senses.definitionCN: 在商业组织内部推动环境标准的雇员或管理者
senses.example: The firm's environmentalist blocked the cheaper but dirtier supplier.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司里的环保倡导者否决了更便宜但更脏的供应商。
senses.why: The same label moves indoors, where protection is argued for rather than protested.
senses.whyCN: 同一个标签搬进了室内，在那里保护是靠论证而不是靠抗议争取的。

senses.title: A label used by opponents
senses.definition: a term applied dismissively by critics to suggest naive or costly priorities
senses.definitionCN: 批评者带轻蔑地使用的称呼，暗示其主张天真或代价高昂
senses.example: Opponents dismissed the plan as an environmentalist fantasy.
senses.exampleCN: 反对者把该方案斥为环保主义者的幻想。
senses.why: Any movement name can be turned against its members, and the agent ending makes the attack personal.
senses.whyCN: 任何运动的名称都可能被反过来针对其成员，而施动词尾使攻击落在个人身上。

senses.title: Distinct from a conservationist or an ecologist
senses.titleCN: 区别于自然保护主义者与生态学家
senses.definition: a label differing from one who manages land for conservation and from a scientist who studies ecosystems
senses.definitionCN: 既不同于为保护而管理土地的人，也不同于研究生态系统的科学家
senses.example: An ecologist measured the loss; an environmentalist campaigned about it.
senses.exampleCN: 生态学家测量了这种损失，环保人士则为它奔走。
senses.why: Three neighbouring words split along the lines of study, management and advocacy, and this one holds the advocacy line.
senses.whyCN: 三个相邻的词沿研究、管理与倡导三条线分开，这个词守住的是倡导那条线。

intro.en: The word is a French-derived noun for surroundings plus an agent ending of Greek origin. Its first recorded use was for a belief about surroundings, not for a campaigner, and the modern sense settled only in the twentieth century.
intro.cn: 这个词是法语来源的「周围环境」名词加上希腊来源的施动词尾。它最早的记录用法指的是关于环境作用的信念，而不是运动者，现代义到二十世纪才稳定下来。

items.en: Environ meant around or about, built from a prefix and a verb for turning or circling.
items.cn: 这个词意为在周围、在附近，由一个前缀与表示「转、绕」的动词构成。

items.en: The noun named the conditions that surround and act on a person or thing.
items.cn: 这个名词指环绕并作用于人或事物的那些条件。

items.en: English borrowed the noun in the nineteenth century and extended it from people to organisms and to the whole physical setting.
items.cn: 英语在十九世纪借入这个名词，把它的对象从人扩展到生物，再扩展到整个物理环境。

items.en: The agent ending marked a person devoted to or siding with something, and English took it through Latin and French.
items.cn: 这个施动词尾标记投身于或站在某一边的人，英语经拉丁语与法语引入。

items.en: The earliest recorded use named someone who held that surroundings shape behaviour, a dispute in psychology rather than politics; the exact first year is uncertain.
items.cn: 最早记录的用法指认为环境塑造行为的人，那是心理学争论而非政治议题；确切首见年份不确定。

items.en: By the mid-twentieth century the same word meant a person who campaigns for the protection of the environment, and that reading now dominates.
items.cn: 到二十世纪中叶，同一个词已指为保护环境而奔走的人，这一读法如今占主导。

note.en: The first group shares the environment stem; the second group splits advocacy from study and from land management.
note.cn: 第一组共用「环境」词干；第二组把倡导与研究、土地管理区分开来。

entries.definition: The surroundings that act on living things, the base noun of the word.
entries.definitionCN: 指作用于生物的周围条件，是该词的基座名词。

entries.definition: Relating to those surroundings, the adjective of the base noun.
entries.definitionCN: 指与这些周围条件有关的形容词。

entries.definition: The movement or doctrine behind the person.
entries.definitionCN: 指这个人背后的运动或主张。

entries.definition: In terms of surroundings, as in environmentally friendly.
entries.definitionCN: 指在环境方面，如「对环境友好地」。

entries.definition: The area around a town, the oldest concrete use of the stem.
entries.definitionCN: 指城镇周边地区，是该词干最早的具体用法。

entries.definition: One who manages land and species for long-term protection rather than campaigning.
entries.definitionCN: 指为长期保护而管理土地与物种的人，重管理轻奔走。

entries.definition: A scientist who studies relationships between organisms and their surroundings.
entries.definitionCN: 指研究生物与其环境关系的科学家。

entries.definition: Anyone who acts publicly for a cause, not necessarily an environmental one.
entries.definitionCN: 指为某项事业公开行动的人，不一定是环境事业。

entries.definition: One who takes direct action for a political or social goal.
entries.definitionCN: 指为政治或社会目标采取直接行动的人。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the French surrounding noun, the agent ending and the three neighbouring labels.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用法语「环绕」名词、施动词尾与三个相邻标签。

normal.en: Environ means around, so the environment is what surrounds you; add the person ending and you get the one who guards it.
normal.cn: 前半意为「环绕」，所以环境就是围着你的东西；加上人称词尾，就是守护它的人。

normal.en: The same ending makes pianist, physicist and environmentalist: a person devoted to the thing named.
normal.cn: 同一个词尾造出钢琴家、物理学家与环保人士：投身于前面那件事的人。

normal.en: The word first meant a believer in the power of surroundings, which is why dictionaries still list that older sense.
normal.cn: 这个词最初指相信环境作用的人，所以词典至今仍列那个旧义。

normal.en: Conservationist manages land, ecologist measures it, environmentalist argues for it.
normal.cn: 自然保护主义者管理土地，生态学家测量土地，环保人士为土地发声。

normal.en: Environmentalist policies is the common attributive use, where the noun does an adjective's work.
normal.cn: 「环保主义政策」是常见的定语用法，名词在这里干形容词的活。

abstract.en: An environmentalist is a person who treats the surroundings as a client that cannot speak.
abstract.cn: 环保人士把周围环境当作一个无法开口的当事人。

abstract.en: The label is a badge and a target at once: the same name that gathers a movement invites attack on its members.
abstract.cn: 这个标签既是徽章也是靶子：聚拢运动的名字同时招来对成员的攻击。

abstract.en: Advocacy begins where measurement ends: someone must carry the number into a room where decisions are made.
abstract.cn: 倡导始于测量结束之处：总得有人把数字带进做决定的那间屋子。

examples.en: The environmentalist spent ten years documenting illegal dumping in the bay.
examples.cn: 这位环保人士用十年时间记录海湾里的非法倾倒。

examples.en: As an environmentalist, she argued that the wetland should be left alone.
examples.cn: 作为环保人士，她主张这片湿地应当保持原样。

examples.en: The magazine called him the country's most influential environmentalist.
examples.cn: 这家杂志称他为该国最有影响力的环保人士。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「因外荣门特利斯特」——因外荣是围在四周，门特是名词尾，利斯特是做事的人：围着环境做事的人

root: 法语 environ「在周围」← en + virer「转、绕」→ environnement「环绕的条件」→ 英语中表示「环境」的名词；再加希腊语来源的表示施动者的词尾「投身于某事的人」。十九世纪末先指相信环境塑造行为的人，二十世纪中叶起指为保护环境而奔走的人，现代义的确切定型年代为约数。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one word from the campaigner on the riverbank to the internal advocate, the political stance, the attributive use and the label used by opponents.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一个词，从河岸上的运动者走到企业内部的倡导者、政治立场、定语用法，以及对立一方使用的标签。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: people clearing a blocked river mouth while a letter to the upstream factory is being signed.
core.cn: 核心意象：人们清理被堵住的河口，同时有人正在签署写给上游工厂的信。

branches.en: THE ACTOR: the person who protects, and the movement member who campaigns.
branches.cn: 行动者：从事保护的人，以及运动中的成员。

branches.en: THE SALARIED ROLE: protection as paid professional work.
branches.cn: 领薪角色：作为有薪专业工作的保护。

branches.en: THE POSITION: an attributive label and a place in party politics.
branches.cn: 立场：作定语的标签，以及政党政治中的一个位置。

branches.en: THE INSIDE ADVOCATE: standards pushed within a company rather than protested outside it.
branches.cn: 内部倡导者：在公司内部推动标准，而非在门外抗议。

branches.en: THE CONTESTED NAME: a term turned against its members, and a line drawn against study and land management.
branches.cn: 有争议的名称：被反过来针对成员的词，以及与研究与土地管理划开的界线。

intro.en: A French prefix and turning verb build the surroundings; a Greek agent ending builds the person.
intro.cn: 法语的前缀与「转」动词搭出「周围」，希腊语的施动词尾搭出「人」。

latinIntro.en: The agent ending reached English through Latin and French, and the Latin entries below record the chain.
latinIntro.cn: 施动词尾经拉丁语与法语进入英语，下列拉丁语词条记录了这条链。

items.example: It turns a turning verb into a placing one.
items.exampleCN: 它把「转」的动词变成「置于其中」。

items.example: The stem supplied the idea of what lies around.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干提供了「在四周」的想法。

items.example: It makes a noun from the verb.
items.exampleCN: 它把动词变成名词。

items.example: It makes the adjective of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 它构成该名词的形容词。

items.meaning: one who sides with or practises
items.example: It makes the person word.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示人的词。

items.example: It makes the name of the cause.
items.exampleCN: 它构成这项事业的名称。

items.example: It makes the adverb of manner.
items.exampleCN: 它构成方式副词。

items.example: It is the recorded French source of the stem.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录的法语词干来源。

derivatives.zh: 由基座名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「环境的」
由该形容词加表示主义的名词词尾构成，义为「环保主义」
由该形容词加副词词尾构成，义为「在环境方面」
该词的复数形式，义为「环保人士们」

definition_zh: 污染；弄脏；玷污；亵渎；使（语言、数据等）变得不纯
definition_en: to put harmful or unwanted substances into air, water or land, or to make something impure, corrupted or ritually unclean
core_image: 一根排水管把暗色液体注进清澈的河湾，水面浮起一层油光，颜色从管口向外散开
scene: 排水管在夜里把暗色液体排进河湾，清晨水面上浮着一层油光。The factory has polluted the bay for years without a permit.
sceneCN: 这里指向水体排放有害物质、使其变脏受损（第 1 个义项：向环境排入有害物质）；句意为这家工厂多年无证污染了海湾。

pos.zh: 污染；弄脏
玷污；亵渎；使不纯

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「污染；污染物」
由该动词加表示「进行者、物质」的名词尾构成，义为「污染物；污染物质」
由该动词加表示施动者的名词尾构成，义为「污染者；排污者」
由该动词加已然词尾构成，义为「受污染的」
由该动词加现在分词词尾构成，义为「造成污染的」
由表示否定的前缀加已然形式构成，义为「未受污染的」
由表示否定的前缀加现在分词构成，义为「不造成污染的」

senses.title: To put harmful substances into the environment
senses.definition: to introduce substances or energy into air, water or soil in amounts that harm living things
senses.definitionCN: 把物质或能量引入空气、水体或土壤，其数量足以伤害生物
senses.example: Runoff from the fields has polluted the stream below the village.
senses.exampleCN: 田地的径流污染了村下游的小溪。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to soil or defile, and industry gave that soiling a physical target: air, water, ground.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词本义是弄脏、玷污，工业给了这种弄脏一个物理对象：空气、水与土地。

senses.title: To make an object dirty or impure
senses.definition: to dirty or contaminate a concrete object so that it is no longer clean or usable
senses.definitionCN: 使一件具体物品变脏或混入杂质，以致不再洁净或可用
senses.example: Dust from the road polluted the open water tank.
senses.exampleCN: 路上的尘土弄脏了敞口的水箱。
senses.why: Before it named an environmental problem, the verb simply meant making a thing unclean.
senses.whyCN: 在它命名环境问题之前，这个动词只表示把东西弄得不再洁净。

senses.title: To desecrate something sacred
senses.definition: to treat a sacred place or rite as common or unclean, in religious and older legal usage
senses.definitionCN: 在宗教与旧式法律用法中，把圣地或圣礼当作凡俗或不洁之物对待
senses.example: The old law forbade anyone to pollute the spring used for the rite.
senses.exampleCN: 旧法禁止任何人玷污仪式所用的泉水。
senses.why: Defilement was a religious category long before it was a chemical one, and the verb kept that weight.
senses.whyCN: 「玷污」在成为化学范畴之前很久就是宗教范畴，这个动词保留了那份重量。

senses.title: To corrupt morals or a community
senses.definition: to degrade the moral character of a person, group or institution
senses.definitionCN: 败坏一个人、群体或制度的道德品质
senses.example: Critics claimed the broadcasts polluted the minds of the young.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者声称这些广播败坏了年轻人的心灵。
senses.why: If impurity can enter a body, it can enter a mind, and the metaphor moved from water to morals.
senses.whyCN: 既然杂质能进入身体，也能进入心灵，这个比喻就从水体移到了道德。

senses.title: To contaminate language or public debate
senses.definition: to fill speech, writing or public argument with falsehood, jargon or abuse until it loses clarity
senses.definitionCN: 让言语、文字或公共论辩充满虚假、行话或谩骂，以致失去清晰
senses.example: Readers said the comment threads had polluted the debate beyond repair.
senses.exampleCN: 读者说这些评论区已经把讨论污染到无法修复。
senses.why: Language is treated as a shared medium like water, and bad content spreads through it the same way.
senses.whyCN: 语言被当作像水一样的共享介质，坏内容以同样的方式在其中扩散。

senses.title: To disturb surroundings with noise or light
senses.titleCN: 以噪声或光干扰周围环境
senses.definition: to degrade an environment with excessive noise, artificial light or heat rather than a substance
senses.definitionCN: 用过量噪声、人工光或废热而不是物质，使环境质量下降
senses.example: The all-night floodlights polluted the darkness the moths depended on.
senses.exampleCN: 彻夜不熄的泛光灯破坏了蛾类赖以生存的黑暗环境。
senses.why: Once pollution meant any harmful addition, energy could pollute as well as matter.
senses.whyCN: 一旦污染被理解为任何有害添加，能量也能像物质一样造成污染。

senses.title: To insert errors into data or records
senses.titleCN: 在数据与记录中掺入错误
senses.definition: to add faulty, duplicated or misleading entries to a dataset or record
senses.definitionCN: 向数据集或记录中加入有误、重复或误导性的条目
senses.example: A bad script polluted the archive with thousands of duplicate rows.
senses.exampleCN: 一段有问题的脚本用成千上万条重复记录污染了档案库。
senses.why: Data is a reservoir that users share, and one bad input spreads through it.
senses.whyCN: 数据是用户共享的水库，一处坏输入就会在其中扩散。

senses.title: To contaminate water or food with pathogens
senses.titleCN: 以病原体污染水体或食物
senses.definition: to introduce bacteria, viruses or parasites into water or food so that it becomes unsafe
senses.definitionCN: 把细菌、病毒或寄生虫引入水或食物，使其不再安全
senses.example: The broken pipe polluted the well water with bacteria.
senses.exampleCN: 破裂的管道用细菌污染了井水。
senses.why: Sanitation workers used the word for germs before environmental agencies used it for chemicals.
senses.whyCN: 卫生工作者比环境机构更早用这个词来说病菌。

senses.title: To be the source of pollution
senses.titleCN: 作为污染的来源与责任方
senses.definition: to cause pollution through discharge, leakage or careless practice, said of an operator
senses.definitionCN: 因排放、泄漏或操作不慎而造成污染，用于指作业者
senses.example: The plant polluted the river while its permit was under appeal.
senses.exampleCN: 这家厂在许可证被申诉期间一直在污染这条河。
senses.why: Attribution matters legally, so the verb came to name the responsible actor as well as the act.
senses.whyCN: 归责在法律上很重要，于是这个动词也用来指负有责任的行为者，而不只是行为。

intro.en: The word came into English through French from a Latin verb meaning to defile. Its parts are a prefix meaning forth and a stem usually connected with washing, a connection that scholars state as the usual view rather than a certainty.
intro.cn: 这个词经法语从拉丁语进入英语，原义为玷污。其构成是一个表示「向前」的前缀与一个通常与「洗」相联系的词干，学界对此只说「一般认为」，并非确证。

items.en: Luere meant to wash or cleanse, and it is usually taken as the second element of the Latin verb, though the link is stated as the usual view.
items.cn: 这个词意为洗、洗净，通常被认为是该拉丁动词的第二成分，不过这一联系只按通行的看法陈述。

items.en: The prefix, an assimilated form of the prefix for forth, added the idea of movement over a surface.
items.cn: 这个前缀是表示「向前」的前缀的同化形式，加上了在表面上移动的意思。

items.en: The verb meant to defile, contaminate or dishonour, and it was used of water, places and sacred things.
items.cn: 这个动词意为玷污、污染、使蒙羞，用于水体、场所与神圣之物。

items.en: The noun named the state of defilement, and it is the direct source of the English noun.
items.cn: 这个名词指被玷污的状态，是英语名词的直接来源。

items.en: Old French carried the verb onward, and English took it in the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 古法语把该动词继续传下，英语在十四世纪借入。

items.en: The industrial age turned a word about defilement into a word about smoke, sewage and chemicals.
items.cn: 工业时代把关于玷污的词变成了关于烟尘、污水与化学品的词。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin stem; the second group names the acts and results of contaminating.
note.cn: 第一组共用拉丁词干；第二组是表示「污染行为与结果」的相邻说法。

entries.definition: The presence of harmful substances, and the act of introducing them.
entries.definitionCN: 指有害物质的存在，也指引入这些物质的行为。

entries.definition: A substance that pollutes when it enters the environment.
entries.definitionCN: 指进入环境后造成污染的物质。

entries.definition: The person or firm responsible for the pollution.
entries.definitionCN: 指对污染负有责任的人或企业。

entries.definition: Already contaminated, used of water, soil or air.
entries.definitionCN: 指已被污染的，用于水、土壤或空气。

entries.definition: The verb itself; a look-alike trap is the noun pollutant, which ends differently.
entries.definitionCN: 动词本身；易混点是名词 pollutant 的词尾不同。

entries.definition: To introduce something harmful, especially germs or a chemical, into a substance or place.
entries.definitionCN: 指向某物或某地引入有害的东西，尤指病菌或化学品。

entries.definition: To make unclean or to treat something sacred with disrespect.
entries.definitionCN: 指弄脏，或以不敬的方式对待神圣之物。

entries.definition: To spoil something by adding a trace of something bad, often used of food and reputation.
entries.definitionCN: 指因混入坏东西而使事物变坏，常用于食物与名誉。

entries.definition: To make something physically unclean, the plain everyday verb.
entries.definitionCN: 指把东西弄脏的日常普通动词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the defilement sense, its recorded family and the modern environmental target.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用「玷污」这一旧义、其有记录的词族与近代的环境对象。

normal.en: The Latin verb meant to defile before it meant to pollute a river, and the older weight still shows in polluted reputation.
normal.cn: 这个拉丁动词先指玷污，后指污染河流，旧有的重量仍见于「名誉被玷污」。

normal.en: Pollution, pollutant, polluter and unpolluted all grow from one stem.
normal.cn: 污染、污染物、污染者与未受污染的，都从同一词干长出。

normal.en: Pollutant ends in a different suffix from pollute, which is why the two are often misspelled.
normal.cn: 污染物一词的词尾与动词不同，这正是两者常被拼错的原因。

normal.en: Heavily polluted is the fixed phrase used in reports about rivers and air.
normal.cn: 「受到严重污染的」是关于河流与空气的报告里的固定说法。

normal.en: The prefix means forth, so the verb pictures something carried out over a surface.
normal.cn: 前缀意为「向前」，所以这个动词的画面是把东西铺到表面上。

abstract.en: Pollution is a cost pushed sideways: the maker keeps the product and gives the residue to everyone.
abstract.cn: 污染是被推向旁边的成本：制造者留下产品，把残渣交给所有人。

abstract.en: The same verb moves from water to minds to data because all three are shared media that one input can spoil.
abstract.cn: 同一个动词从水体移到心灵再移到数据，因为三者都是共享介质，一处输入就能弄坏。

abstract.en: Defilement is a boundary crossed: something clean and set apart has been made common.
abstract.cn: 玷污是一条边界被越过：本来洁净、被分隔开的东西被弄得凡俗了。

examples.en: The old smelter polluted the soil across three villages.
examples.cn: 那座旧冶炼厂污染了三个村庄的土壤。

examples.en: Discharge from the ships polluted the harbour with oil.
examples.cn: 船只的排放用油污染了港口。

examples.en: Editors warned that rumours had polluted the public record.
examples.cn: 编辑们警告说谣言已经污染了公共记录。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「泼路特」——泼在路上，脏水泼进河里，就把水污染了；泼脏话，就把风气玷污了

root: 拉丁语 polluere「玷污、污染」← por-（向前，pro- 的同化形式）+ 词干 luere「洗」，后半与「洗」的联系一般认为是通行看法而非确证；名词 pollutio 为直接来源。英语十四世纪经古法语借入，先指玷污与亵渎，工业时代起指对空气、水体与土壤的污染。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses keep the old weight of defilement while moving outward: water and air, objects, sacred places, morals, language, noise and light, data, germs and the responsible actor.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项保留「玷污」的旧重量并向外移动：水体与空气、器物、圣地、道德、语言、噪声与光、数据、病菌，以及负有责任的行为者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pipe pours dark liquid into a clear bay, and the colour spreads outward from the mouth.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根管子把暗色液体倒进清澈的海湾，颜色从管口向外散开。

branches.en: THE PHYSICAL SPOILING: harmful inputs into air, water and soil, and dirt added to a plain object.
branches.cn: 物理弄脏：有害输入进入空气、水与土壤，以及加到普通器物上的污物。

branches.en: THE INWARD DEFILEMENT: sacred places treated as common, and morals treated as a body that impurity can enter.
branches.cn: 向内的玷污：被当作凡俗的圣地，以及被当作可让杂质进入的道德。

branches.en: THE SHARED MEDIUM: language and public debate, and datasets filled with bad entries.
branches.cn: 共享介质：语言与公共讨论，以及被坏条目填满的数据集。

branches.en: THE OTHER CARRIERS: noise and light, and germs in water or food.
branches.cn: 其他载体：噪声与光，以及水体或食物中的病菌。

branches.en: THE LEDGER OF BLAME: the operator who discharges and is named as the source.
branches.cn: 责任账目：实施排放并被指名为来源的作业者。

intro.en: A prefix for forth and a stem usually read as washing make the Latin verb; English derived a whole family from it.
intro.cn: 一个表示「向前」的前缀与一个通常读作「洗」的词干构成拉丁动词，英语由此派生了一整族词。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the verb, its noun and its participle; the reading of the second element as washing is the usual view, not a certainty.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了动词、名词与分词；把第二成分读作「洗」是通行看法，并非确证。

items.example: The verb carries the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 整个词族都由这个动词承载。

items.example: It pictures something carried out over a surface.
items.exampleCN: 它画出把东西铺到表面上的画面。

items.example: It is the usual reading of the second element.
items.exampleCN: 这是对第二成分的通行解读。

items.example: It is the recorded direct source.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录的直接来源。

items.example: It makes the noun pollution.
items.exampleCN: 它构成名词「污染」。

items.example: It makes the word for a polluting substance.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示污染物质的词。

items.example: It makes the word for the responsible party.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示责任方的词。

items.example: It marks water or air that is still clean.
items.exampleCN: 它标记仍然洁净的水或空气。

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加动作名词词尾构成，义为「污染」
由该动词加表示作用物的名词词尾构成，义为「污染物」
由该动词加施动名词词尾构成，义为「污染者」
由否定前缀加已然分词构成，义为「未受污染的」

definition_zh: 可生物降解的；能被微生物分解的
definition_en: able to be broken down by living organisms, especially microorganisms, into simple natural substances
core_image: 一只纸盒埋在湿土里，边缘被菌丝啃成缺口，半年后只剩几片碎屑与深色的土
scene: 公园把塑料餐盒换成纸浆做的盒子，埋进堆肥坑里几个月后就只剩碎屑。The coffee shop now serves its meals in biodegradable trays.
sceneCN: 这里指材料能被微生物分解成简单天然物质（第 1 个义项：可被生物分解）；句意为这家咖啡馆现在用可生物降解的餐盘盛饭。

pos.zh: 可生物降解的；能被微生物分解的

derivatives.zh: 由表示「生命」的成分加表示「降级、分解」的动词构成，义为「生物降解」
由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「生物降解过程」
由该形容词加表示性质的名词尾构成，义为「可生物降解性」
该词去掉表示「生命」的成分后剩下的形容词，义为「可降解的」，降解方式不限
由表示否定的前缀加该词构成，义为「不可生物降解的」
相邻术语，指可在堆肥条件下分解并产出可用堆肥，义为「可堆肥的」

senses.title: Breakable down by living organisms
senses.definition: able to be decomposed by bacteria, fungi or other organisms rather than only by heat, light or chemicals
senses.definitionCN: 能被细菌、真菌或其他生物分解，而不是只能靠热、光或化学品分解
senses.example: The liner is biodegradable, so it breaks down in soil within a season.
senses.exampleCN: 这种衬垫是可生物降解的，因此在一个季节内就能在土壤里分解。
senses.why: The first element means life and the last means able to be, so the word says living things can take it apart.
senses.whyCN: 前一个成分意为「生命」，后一个成分意为「能够被……」，因此这个词说的是活物能把它拆开。

senses.title: Leaving only harmless natural products
senses.titleCN: 分解后只留下无害的天然物质
senses.definition: breaking down into water, carbon dioxide, biomass and simple minerals rather than toxic residue
senses.definitionCN: 分解为水、二氧化碳、生物质与简单矿物质，而不是留下有毒残留
senses.example: A material is only fully biodegradable if no harmful residue is left behind.
senses.exampleCN: 一种材料只有不留下有害残留，才算完全可生物降解。
senses.why: Complete breakdown is judged by what remains, which is why the claim is tested rather than assumed.
senses.whyCN: 完全分解要看剩下什么来判断，这正是这一说法需要检测而不能想当然的原因。

senses.title: Dependent on specific conditions
senses.definition: requiring the right microbes, moisture, oxygen and temperature before decomposition can proceed
senses.definitionCN: 需要合适的微生物、湿度、氧气与温度，分解才能进行
senses.example: The bag is biodegradable but needs a warm, moist compost heap to break down at all.
senses.exampleCN: 这种袋子可生物降解，但必须有温暖潮湿的堆肥堆才能真正分解。
senses.why: Microbes are living workers, so their working conditions become conditions of the material.
senses.whyCN: 微生物是活着的工人，因此它们的工作条件就成了这种材料的条件。

senses.title: A property of packaging and products
senses.titleCN: 包装与制品的一项属性
senses.definition: a stated property of films, trays, bags, cutlery and detergents sold as environmentally preferable
senses.definitionCN: 薄膜、托盘、袋子、餐具与洗涤剂等被宣称为更环保产品时标明的属性
senses.example: The shop prints biodegradable on the box, but not the conditions needed.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店在盒子上印了「可生物降解」，却没有印所需的分解条件。
senses.why: The word became a marketing attribute once disposable goods needed an environmental defence.
senses.whyCN: 一次性用品需要环境方面的辩护时，这个词就成了一种营销属性。

senses.title: Compostable as a stricter claim
senses.titleCN: 可堆肥：更严格的一类声称
senses.definition: able to break down in a defined composting system within a set time and leave usable compost
senses.definitionCN: 能在规定的堆肥系统内于限定时间内分解，并留下可用的堆肥
senses.example: The fork is compostable at industrial temperatures but not biodegradable in a garden heap.
senses.exampleCN: 这把叉子能在工业温度下堆肥分解，在花园堆肥堆里却不能生物降解。
senses.why: Composting adds a time limit and a quality test, so it is the narrower and better-evidenced claim.
senses.whyCN: 堆肥增加了时间限制与质量检验，因此是更窄、证据更充分的说法。

senses.title: Distinct from merely degradable
senses.definition: differing from degradable, which covers breakdown by light, heat or mechanical action as well as microbes
senses.definitionCN: 与「可降解」不同，后者把光、热或机械作用造成的分解也计算在内
senses.example: A photodegradable sheet fragments in sunlight yet is not biodegradable.
senses.exampleCN: 一种光降解薄膜在阳光下会碎裂，却不是可生物降解的。
senses.why: Fragmenting is not decomposing, and the word keeps that distinction by naming the living agent.
senses.whyCN: 碎裂不等于分解，这个词通过点明「生物」这一作用者来守住这条界线。

senses.title: A certification and label claim
senses.definition: a claim checked against a published standard before it may appear on a product
senses.definitionCN: 须按已发布标准检验后才能出现在产品上的声称
senses.example: Only two of the nine bags carried a certified biodegradable mark.
senses.exampleCN: 九种袋子中只有两种带有经认证的可生物降解标志。
senses.why: Because the word sells, it needed standards to stop it from meaning nothing.
senses.whyCN: 正因为这个词能卖货，才需要标准来防止它变得毫无意义。

senses.title: Limited in a landfill
senses.definition: decomposing very slowly or not at all when buried without oxygen in a sealed landfill
senses.definitionCN: 在缺氧的封闭填埋场中被埋时分解极慢，甚至完全不分解
senses.example: Buried without air, even a biodegradable cup may release methane for decades.
senses.exampleCN: 在无氧条件下被埋，即使可生物降解的杯子也可能数十年持续释放甲烷。
senses.why: The adjective describes a capacity, not a guarantee, and the missing conditions explain the gap.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词描述一种能力，而不是一项保证，缺失的条件正好解释了这一落差。

senses.title: A timescale rather than an instant
senses.definition: breaking down over months or years, with the duration depending on material and setting
senses.definitionCN: 在数月或数年尺度上分解，时长取决于材料与所处环境
senses.example: The manufacturer states that the tray is biodegradable within ninety days in commercial compost.
senses.exampleCN: 制造商说明这种托盘在商业堆肥条件下九十天内可生物降解。
senses.why: Living decomposition is slow by nature, so any label for it has to carry a period.
senses.whyCN: 生物分解天生缓慢，因此任何相关标注都必须带上一个时间。

intro.en: The word is a twentieth-century compound. A Greek element for life is joined to a Latin verb for stepping down, and an English adjective ending completes it.
intro.cn: 这个词是二十世纪复合词：希腊语的「生命」成分接上拉丁语表示「逐级下降」的动词，再由英语形容词词尾收尾。

items.en: Bios meant life, and it became the standard first element in compounds about living processes.
items.cn: 这个词意为生命，后来成了表示生命过程的复合词的标准前项。

items.en: Gradus meant a step, and it supplied the image of moving down one level at a time.
items.cn: 这个词意为一步、一级，提供了「一级一级往下走」的形象。

items.en: The verb meant to lower in rank, built from the prefix for down and the noun for step.
items.cn: 这个动词意为降低等级，由表示「向下」的前缀与表示「级」的名词构成。

items.en: French carried the verb into English in the fourteenth century, first as a word about rank and later about condition.
items.cn: 法语把这个动词带入英语，时在十四世纪，先指等级，后指状态。

items.en: The ending meant able to be, and it turned the verb into a capacity rather than an event.
items.cn: 这个词尾意为「能够被……」，把动词变成一种能力而非一次事件。

items.en: Chemists and packaging engineers formed the compound in the mid-twentieth century; its exact first appearance is dated only approximately.
items.cn: 化学家与包装工程师在二十世纪中叶造出这个复合词；其确切首见时间只能给约数。

note.en: The first group shares the life or step element; the second group names other ways materials break down.
note.cn: 第一组共用「生命」或「级」的成分；第二组是材料分解的其他方式。

entries.definition: The verb for being broken down by living organisms.
entries.definitionCN: 指被生物分解的动词。

entries.definition: The process itself, as studied and measured.
entries.definitionCN: 指被研究与测量的分解过程本身。

entries.definition: The property of being able to decompose biologically.
entries.definitionCN: 指可被生物分解的性质。

entries.definition: Able to break down by any means, including light and heat.
entries.definitionCN: 指能通过任何方式分解，包括光与热。

entries.definition: Variety of life; it shares the life element but belongs to the variety stem.
entries.definitionCN: 指生命多样性；共用「生命」成分，但属于「多样」词干。

entries.definition: Able to break down in a composting system within a stated time and leave usable compost.
entries.definitionCN: 指能在堆肥系统内于规定时间分解并留下可用堆肥。

entries.definition: Able to be broken down into simpler parts, without saying by what.
entries.definitionCN: 指能被分解成更简单的部分，但不说由什么分解。

entries.definition: Broken down by light, which may leave fragments rather than simple substances.
entries.definitionCN: 指由光分解，可能留下碎片而非简单物质。

entries.definition: Able to be processed into new material, a different route from decomposition.
entries.definitionCN: 指能被加工成新材料，是与分解不同的一条路径。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations take the word apart into life, step and capacity, then put it back into a compost heap.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想把词拆成「生命」「级」与「能力」，再把它放回堆肥堆里。

normal.en: Bio is life, degrade is stepping down, and able says it can be done: life can step it down.
normal.cn: 前项是生命，动词是逐级下降，词尾是「能够」：活物能把它降下来。

normal.en: Biodegrade and biodegradation are the verb and the process; the adjective ends in a different suffix.
normal.cn: 动词与过程各有其词形，形容词的词尾又不同。

normal.en: Compostable is the stronger claim, because it adds a time limit and a quality test.
normal.cn: 「可堆肥」是更强的说法，因为它加了时限与质量检验。

normal.en: A sealed landfill has no oxygen, so even a degradable cup may last for decades.
normal.cn: 封闭填埋场没有氧气，所以即使可降解杯子也可能存留数十年。

normal.en: The label should carry a period, because biological breakdown is measured in months, not minutes.
normal.cn: 标签应当带时限，因为生物分解以月计，而不是以分钟计。

abstract.en: Biodegradable is a promise about the future made by a material that cannot keep it alone; it needs a place with the right microbes.
abstract.cn: 「可生物降解」是材料对未来作出的承诺，而它无法独自兑现，需要一个有合适微生物的地方。

abstract.en: Being edible to microbes is not the same as being harmless: what matters is what is left after the meal.
abstract.cn: 能被微生物吃掉不等于无害，关键是这顿饭吃完剩下什么。

abstract.en: Every claim of return to nature rests on a hidden set of conditions, and those conditions are the real subject.
abstract.cn: 每一种「回归自然」的说法都依赖一整套隐性条件，而那套条件才是真正的主题。

examples.en: The new mulch is fully biodegradable and breaks down within one season.
examples.cn: 这种新覆盖物完全可生物降解，一个季节内就会分解。

examples.en: Biodegradable bags still need oxygen to decompose, so they fail in sealed landfills.
examples.cn: 可生物降解袋子仍需氧气才能分解，因此在封闭填埋场里失效。

examples.en: The lab tested whether the film was biodegradable under soil conditions.
examples.cn: 实验室检测了这种薄膜在土壤条件下是否可生物降解。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「拜欧迪格雷德波」——拜欧是生命，迪格雷德是降级，波是能够：生命能够把它降级拆开

root: 希腊语 bios「生命」+ 拉丁语 degradare「降低等级」← de-「向下」+ gradus「级、步」；英语经法语于十四世纪引入表示「降级」的动词，二十世纪中叶再加表示「能够被……」的词尾构成该形容词，确切首见时间只能给约数。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses separate what the word promises from what it requires: the living agent, the harmless residue, the conditions, the product, the stricter compost claim, the weaker degradable claim, certification, landfills and time.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项把承诺与前提分开：分解者、无害残留、所需条件、产品属性、更严的堆肥声称、更宽的降解说法、认证、填埋场与时间尺度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a paper tray in damp soil, its edges eaten away by fungal threads into crumbs.
core.cn: 核心意象：湿土里的一只纸托盘，边缘被菌丝啃成碎屑。

branches.en: THE AGENT: bacteria and fungi do the work, not heat or light.
branches.cn: 作用者：干活的是细菌与真菌，而不是热或光。

branches.en: THE RESIDUE: what is left must be water, gas, biomass and minerals.
branches.cn: 残留：剩下必须是水、气体、生物质与矿物。

branches.en: THE CONDITIONS AND THE CLOCK: microbes need moisture, air and warmth, and the process runs in months or years.
branches.cn: 条件与时钟：微生物需要湿度、空气与温度，过程以月或年计。

branches.en: THE MARKET AND THE CHECK: a product attribute that must be certified before it sells.
branches.cn: 市场与检验：一种必须先经认证才能售卖的产品属性。

branches.en: THE NEIGHBOURING CLAIMS: a stricter compost standard on one side, a looser degradable one on the other.
branches.cn: 邻近声称：一边是更严的堆肥标准，一边是更宽的降解说法。

intro.en: Three elements make the word: a Greek life element, a Latin step verb and a Latin capacity ending.
intro.cn: 三个成分构成这个词：希腊语「生命」、拉丁语「逐级下降」动词与拉丁语「能够」词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies gradus, degradare and the ending -abilis, all recorded forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了「级」「降低等级」与词尾三种有记录的形式。

items.example: It names the agent that does the work.
items.exampleCN: 它点明干活的作用者。

items.example: It marks movement to a lower state.
items.exampleCN: 它标记向更低状态的移动。

items.example: It gives the sense of one level at a time.
items.exampleCN: 它给出「一级一级」的意思。

items.example: It turns an event into a capacity.
items.exampleCN: 它把事件变成能力。

items.example: It names the process itself.
items.exampleCN: 它命名过程本身。

items.example: It names the property.
items.exampleCN: 它命名这一性质。

items.example: It is the verb behind the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它是形容词背后的动词。

items.example: It marks material that microbes cannot use.
items.exampleCN: 它标记微生物用不了的材料。

derivatives.zh: 由该形容词去掉词尾并还原为动词，义为「生物降解」
由该动词加过程名词词尾构成，义为「生物降解过程」
由该形容词加性质名词词尾构成，义为「可生物降解性」
由否定前缀加该形容词构成，义为「不可生物降解的」

definition_zh: 生态系统恢复；协助退化或受损生态系统回到可自我维持状态的过程
definition_en: the process of assisting a degraded or damaged ecosystem to recover its structure, species and self-sustaining processes
core_image: 一片曾经被砍光的坡地先被围起来，再补种本地树苗，几年后溪水的颜色从褐变清
scene: 伐木停止后，山坡先封育三年，再按原来的树种补种，溪水慢慢变清。The park began ecosystem restoration once the logging licence expired.
sceneCN: 这里指协助受损生态系统恢复结构与功能的过程（第 1 个义项：协助退化生态系统恢复）；句意为伐木许可到期后，公园开始了生态系统恢复工作。

pos.zh: 生态系统恢复（不可数短语名词）
生态系统恢复项目（可数用法，指一项具体工程）

derivatives.zh: 该短语的核心动词，由拉丁语表示「重新建立」的词而来，义为「恢复；修复」
由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「恢复；修复」
由该名词的词干加形容词词尾构成，义为「有恢复作用的」
由该名词与「生态学」组合而成，义为「恢复生态学」，指研究恢复的学科
相邻术语，指使受损系统恢复部分功能而非完整结构，义为「修复；复健」
相邻术语，指清除污染物而非重建群落，义为「治理；修复污染」

senses.title: Assisting a degraded system to recover
senses.definition: the deliberate process of helping a damaged ecosystem regain its structure, species and processes
senses.definitionCN: 有意帮助受损生态系统重新获得结构、物种与运转过程的过程
senses.example: Ecosystem restoration began with fencing the gully and stopping the grazing.
senses.exampleCN: 生态系统恢复从围住冲沟、停止放牧开始。
senses.why: The noun is from a verb meaning to rebuild, so the phrase presents recovery as work done rather than waiting.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词出自意为「重新建立」的动词，因此短语把恢复呈现为做出来的工作，而不是等待。

senses.title: Active intervention rather than neglect
senses.definition: intervention such as removing a stressor, reintroducing species or reshaping the ground
senses.definitionCN: 移除胁迫因素、重新引入物种或重塑地面等干预措施
senses.example: Every ecosystem restoration site here needed weed control in the first two years.
senses.exampleCN: 这里每一个生态系统恢复点，头两年都需要控制杂草。
senses.why: Passive recovery happens on its own; restoration adds hands, and the phrase marks that addition.
senses.whyCN: 被动恢复会自行发生，恢复则加上了人的手，这个短语标记的正是这份添加。

senses.title: A reference state to aim at
senses.definition: a described target condition, often drawn from a nearby intact site or from historical records
senses.definitionCN: 被描述的目标状态，通常取自附近未受损的地点或历史记录
senses.example: The plan named a nearby intact fen as the reference for ecosystem restoration.
senses.exampleCN: 方案把附近一片未受损的沼泽定为生态系统恢复的参照。
senses.why: A target has to be specific or the work cannot be judged, so restoration always borrows a picture from somewhere intact.
senses.whyCN: 目标必须具体，否则无法评判工作，因此恢复总要从未受损之处借来一幅图。

senses.title: A branch of applied ecology
senses.titleCN: 应用生态学的一个分支
senses.definition: the science that tests methods for recovery and measures their outcomes
senses.definitionCN: 检验恢复方法并测量其成效的学科
senses.example: Students of ecosystem restoration compare seeded and naturally regenerated plots.
senses.exampleCN: 学习生态系统恢复的学生比较播种地块与自然更新地块。
senses.why: Practice needs a discipline, so the phrase also names the applied science that tests whether recovery methods work.
senses.whyCN: 实践需要学科支撑，因此这个短语也命名检验恢复方法是否有效的应用科学。

senses.title: A policy commitment and programme
senses.definition: a government or international programme with targets, funding and reporting
senses.definitionCN: 带有目标、资金与报告要求的政府或国际计划
senses.example: The national ecosystem restoration targets cover a quarter of the degraded catchment.
senses.exampleCN: 国家的生态系统恢复目标覆盖了这个退化流域的四分之一。
senses.why: Money and targets turn a method into a programme, and the phrase follows the work into public budgets.
senses.whyCN: 资金与目标把方法变成计划，这个短语也随之进入公共预算。

senses.title: Distinct from rehabilitation and remediation
senses.titleCN: 区别于修复与污染治理
senses.definition: a fuller aim than repairing function or cleaning a pollutant, because structure and species are also rebuilt
senses.definitionCN: 比修复功能或清除污染物更完整的目标，因为结构与物种也要重建
senses.example: Cleaning the soil was remediation; rebuilding the floodplain was ecosystem restoration.
senses.exampleCN: 清理土壤属于污染治理，重建漫滩才属于生态系统恢复。
senses.why: Neighbouring words clean or patch, and the phrase is reserved for work that rebuilds structure and species as well.
senses.whyCN: 相邻的词只做清洁或修补，这个短语留给同时重建结构与物种的工作。

senses.title: Measurable outcomes
senses.definition: results reported as returning species, restored flows, soil carbon or reduced erosion
senses.definitionCN: 以回归的物种、恢复的水流、土壤碳或减少的侵蚀报告出来的结果
senses.example: After six years the ecosystem restoration had brought back three lost plant species.
senses.exampleCN: 六年后，这项生态系统恢复带回了三种消失的植物。
senses.why: A restoration that cannot show returns is indistinguishable from gardening, so results became part of the term.
senses.whyCN: 看不出回报的恢复与园艺没有区别，因此成效成了这个术语的一部分。

senses.title: Community involvement and long-term care
senses.definition: work shared with local users and continued through monitoring and maintenance
senses.definitionCN: 与当地使用者共同承担、并通过监测与维护延续的工作
senses.example: Villagers joined the ecosystem restoration because the spring they used had dried.
senses.exampleCN: 村民加入了这项生态系统恢复，因为他们用的那眼泉已经干了。
senses.why: Recovery needs labour for years, and the phrase covers the people who supply it as well as the ecology it aims at.
senses.whyCN: 恢复需要多年的劳力，这个短语既覆盖它瞄准的生态，也覆盖提供劳力的人。

senses.title: A long horizon
senses.definition: an effort measured in decades, since rebuilt systems need time to assemble themselves
senses.definitionCN: 以数十年计的工作，因为重建的系统需要时间自行组合
senses.example: The ecosystem restoration will not be judged for twenty years.
senses.exampleCN: 这项生态系统恢复在二十年内都不会被下最终结论。
senses.why: Rebuilt systems assemble slowly, so the honest unit of judgement is a decade rather than a season.
senses.whyCN: 重建的系统组合得慢，因此诚实的评判单位是十年，而不是一个季节。

intro.en: The phrase pairs a term coined in nineteen thirty-five from two Greek words with a Latin-derived noun for rebuilding, carried into English through French.
intro.cn: 这个短语用一九三五年由两个希腊词造出的术语，配上一个源自拉丁语、经法语进入英语的「重建」名词。

items.en: Oikos meant house or household, and it supplied the idea of the whole place where life is carried on.
items.cn: 这个词意为房屋或家户，提供了「生命在其中展开的整个场所」这一想法。

items.en: Systema meant an organized whole of parts, and it named the unit built from organisms and setting.
items.cn: 这个词意为由部分组成的有机整体，命名了由生物与环境构成的单位。

items.en: Tansley coined ecosystem to treat organisms and their physical surroundings as one working unit.
items.cn: 坦斯利造出表示「生态系统」的新词，把生物与其物理环境视为一个运转的单位。

items.en: The verb meant to rebuild or renew, built from the prefix for again and a stem for standing.
items.cn: 这个动词意为重建、更新，由表示「再次」的前缀与表示「站立」的词干构成。

items.en: French carried the noun into English, where it first meant rebuilding a building or a monarchy.
items.cn: 法语把这个名词带入英语，最初指重建建筑或王权。

items.en: Ecologists adopted the noun for the rebuilding of living systems, and the phrase became standard in the nineteen eighties; its exact first use is dated only approximately.
items.cn: 生态学家把这个名词用于重建生命系统，这个短语在二十世纪八十年代成为标准说法；确切首见年代只能给约数。

note.en: The first group shares ecosystem or restore; the second group names the neighbouring practices that stop short of full recovery.
note.cn: 第一组共用 ecosystem 或 restore；第二组是停在完整恢复之前的相邻做法。

entries.definition: The act of bringing something back to a former condition.
entries.definitionCN: 指把事物恢复到从前状态的行为。

entries.definition: The verb behind the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 名词背后的动词。

entries.definition: Having the power to restore strength or condition.
entries.definitionCN: 指具有恢复体力或状态作用的。

entries.definition: The unit being restored.
entries.definitionCN: 指被恢复的那个单位。

entries.definition: A place where food restores you; it shares the same Latin verb but a different trade.
entries.definitionCN: 指供人进食恢复精力的地方；共用同一个拉丁动词，但属另一行业。

entries.definition: Bringing a damaged system back to partial function without rebuilding full structure.
entries.definitionCN: 指使受损系统恢复部分功能，但不重建完整结构。

entries.definition: Removing or neutralising a pollutant from soil or water.
entries.definitionCN: 指从土壤或水体中清除或中和污染物。

entries.definition: Converting damaged land to a new declared use, often not the original one.
entries.definitionCN: 指把受损土地改为新的申报用途，往往不是原来的用途。

entries.definition: Restoring wild processes with minimal ongoing human management.
entries.definitionCN: 指以尽量少的人为持续管理恢复野性过程。
